inputs.original_text: US-Israel-Iran War Amid escalating Middle East tensions the US proposed a 15-point ceasefire plan to Iran via Pakistan Iran however presented five counter-conditions seeking an end to aggression compensation and recognition of Strait of Hormuz sovereignty Israel remains sceptical of Irans acceptance and emphasises its right to pre-emptive strikes highlighting the complex demands from all sides to end the ongoing conflict
inputs.modified_text: With tensions escalating in the Middle East, the US has proposed a 15-point ceasefire plan to Iran through Pakistan. Iran responded with five counter-conditions, including an end to aggression, compensation, and recognition of its sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz. Israel remains sceptical that Iran will accept the plan and has emphasised its right to pre-emptive strikes, highlighting the complex demands facing efforts to end the ongoing conflict.
